note: Written after the search had been tuned on the other two sets, and run once, without changing the search afterwards. It is the best available estimate of accuracy on new questions. The same author wrote the articles and the questions, so real visitors will do worse. After this run, the search was changed (stricter typo correction, questions about words the help never uses are no longer answered, three help articles gained wording), so this set is now a tuning set too. `ok` marks questions where an answer from the named article is correct; "how do I edit a video" moved from out of scope to answered when the help gained a section on editing.
